description: This file defines the 'ColumnLeft' controller class within the OpenCart admin backend. It generates the left-hand menu for the admin interface, including main menu items, submenus, extension links, fraud extensions, and statistical data about orders. The class loads language files, models, and views, and constructs a hierarchical menu structure based on database-driven menu items.

classes.name: ColumnLeft
classes.description: Controller class responsible for constructing the admin panel's left sidebar menu, including main sections, submenus, extension links, fraud extensions, and order statistics.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that builds the menu data array to be rendered in the 'common/column_left' view. It verifies user token for security, loads language, models, and dynamically assembles menu items based on database entries and extension statuses, as well as computing order statistics.
